{
  "name": "spank",
  "version": "0.8.0",
  "description": "Slap your MacBook and Claude Code feels it: a face, a yelp, and optionally a stopped turn",
  "author": {
    "name": "Slim",
    "url": "https://github.com/slima4"
  },
  "repository": "https://github.com/slima4/spank-claude",
  "license": "MIT",
  "types": "./types/index.d.ts",
  "userConfig": {
    "threshold": {
      "type": "number",
      "title": "Slap sensitivity (g)",
      "description": "The smallest shake that counts as a slap, in g; level 1 starts here and level 5 at 1 g. Raise it if typing counts as slapping; lower it if desk knocks are missed.",
      "default": 0.05,
      "min": 0.01,
      "max": 1
    },
    "stop_level": {
      "type": "number",
      "title": "Level that stops Claude",
      "description": "With /slaps claude on, a slap of this level (1-5) or harder stops Claude's running turn.",
      "default": 4,
      "min": 1,
      "max": 5
    },
    "face_series": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Face series",
      "description": "Whose face pops up after a slap, and whose voice yelps.",
      "options": [
        "sakura",
        "natsu",
        "aki"
      ],
      "default": "sakura"
    },
    "face_size": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Face size",
      "description": "How big the face above the prompt may get; it shrinks to fit the terminal either way.",
      "options": [
        "large",
        "medium",
        "small",
        "off"
      ],
      "default": "large"
    },
    "volume": {
      "type": "number",
      "title": "Voice volume",
      "description": "0 is silent, 1 is as recorded, up to 4.",
      "default": 1,
      "min": 0,
      "max": 4
    }
  }
}
